verdict.rationale: Firestore documents "atomic batch operations" for multi-document writes, and the firebase-tools CLI supports bulk import/export of Auth users, so Firebase has its own bulk capabilities that an AI-native user could drive through the CLI. The evidence is a few thin one-line mentions, though, with no detail on batch size limits or bulk update/delete across query results, and no sign that the MCP server exposes bulk operations. Missing for 10: documented batch limits and depth, bulk update/delete by query, bulk operations exposed via MCP/agent tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
